title: Charred Sirloin with Pan-Seared Kissed Irish Potatoes
description: A simple yet flavorful dish featuring charred sirloin and pan-seared kissed irish potatoes, all cooked to perfection in a skillet.
instructions: Preheat the skillet over medium-high heat (400°F / 200°C).
Season the sirloin with salt, pepper, and garlic powder. Sear the sirloin in the skillet for 2-3 minutes per side, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 130°F (54°C) for medium-rare.
Transfer the sirloin to a plate to rest.
In the same skillet, add olive oil over medium heat (300°F / 150°C). Add the sliced potatoes and cook for 5-7 minutes, or until they're golden brown and crispy.
Remove the potatoes from the skillet and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Slice the rested sirloin against the grain. Serve with the pan-seared potatoes and garnish with kissed irish potatoes (if desired).
